arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ تُحِبُّونَهَاۖ نَصْرࣱ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَفَتْحࣱ قَرِيبࣱۗ وَبَشِّرِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝١٣
translation: ˹He will also give you˺ another favour that you long for: help from Allah and an imminent victory. ˹So˺ give good news ˹O Prophet˺ to the believers.

arabic: فَإِذَا قُضِيَتِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةُ فَٱنتَشِرُوا۟ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرࣰا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۝١٠
translation: Once the prayer is over, disperse throughout the land and seek the bounty of Allah. And remember Allah often so you may be successful.

arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ ۝٣
translation: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He shaped you ˹in the womb˺, perfecting your form. And to Him is the final return.

arabic: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِۗ وَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِٱللَّهِ يَهْدِ قَلْبَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمࣱ ۝١١
translation: No calamity befalls ˹anyone˺ except by Allah’s Will. And whoever has faith in Allah, He will ˹rightly˺ guide their hearts ˹through adversity˺. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.

arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۝١٣
translation: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. So in Allah let the believers put their trust.

arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ وَٱسْمَعُوا۟ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ خَيْرࣰا لِّأَنفُسِكُمْۗ وَمَن يُوقَ شُحَّ نَفْسِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ ۝١٦
translation: So be mindful of Allah to the best of your ability, hear and obey, and spend in charity—that will be best for you. And whoever is saved from the selfishness of their own souls, it is they who are ˹truly˺ successful.

arabic: ذَٰلِكَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ أَنزَلَهُۥٓ إِلَيْكُمْۚ وَمَن يَتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ يُكَفِّرْ عَنْهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِۦ وَيُعْظِمْ لَهُۥٓ أَجْرًا ۝٥
translation: This is the commandment of Allah, which He has revealed to you. And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will absolve them of their sins and reward them immensely.

arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِي بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءࣲ قَدِيرٌ ۝١
translation: Blessed is the One in Whose Hands rests all authority. And He is Most Capable of everything.

arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلࣰاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ ۝٢
translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who created death and life in order to test which of you is best in deeds. And He is the Almighty, All-Forgiving.

arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ ۝١٣
translation: Whether you speak secretly or openly—He surely knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.

arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ ۝١٤
translation: How could He not know His Own creation? For He ˹alone˺ is the Most Subtle, All-Aware.

arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولࣰا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِي مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ ۝١٥
translation: He is the One Who smoothed out the earth for you, so move about in its regions and eat from His provisions. And to Him is the resurrection ˹of all˺.

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمࣲ ۝٤
translation: And you are truly ˹a man˺ of outstanding character.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ ۝٣٤
translation: Indeed, the righteous will have the Gardens of Bliss with their Lord.

arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِي ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ ۝٢٤
translation: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink joyfully for what you did in the days gone by.”

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ ۝٢٣
translation: consistently performing their prayers;

arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارࣰا ۝١٠
translation: saying, ‘Seek your Lord’s forgiveness, ˹for˺ He is truly Most Forgiving.

arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارࣰا ۝١١
translation: He will shower you with abundant rain,

arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلࣲ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرࣰا ۝١٢
translation: supply you with wealth and children, and give you gardens as well as rivers.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلࣰا ۝٨
translation: ˹Always˺ remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.

arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلࣰا ۝٩
translation: ˹He is the˺ Lord of the east and the west. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, so take Him ˹alone˺ as a Trustee of Affairs.

arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ ۝١٧
translation: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it.

arabic: عَيْنࣰا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرࣰا ۝٦
translation: ˹from˺ a spring where Allah’s servants will drink, flowing at their will.

arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَلَا شُكُورًا ۝٩
translation: ˹saying to themselves,˺ “We feed you only for the sake of Allah, seeking neither reward nor thanks from you.

arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةࣰ وَحَرِيرࣰا ۝١٢
translation: and reward them for their perseverance with a Garden ˹in Paradise˺ and ˹garments of˺ silk.

arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءࣰ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا ۝٢٢
translation: ˹And they will be told,˺ “All this is surely a reward for you. Your striving has been appreciated.”

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلࣲ وَعُيُونࣲ ۝٤١
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs

arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ ۝٤٤
translation: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا ۝٣١
translation: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ ۝٤٠
translation: And as for those who were in awe of standing before their Lord and restrained themselves from ˹evil˺ desires,

arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ ۝٤١
translation: Paradise will certainly be ˹their˺ home.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ ۝٢٢
translation: Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,

arabic: عَيْنࣰا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ ۝٢٨
translation: a spring from which those nearest ˹to Allah˺ will drink.

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونِۭ ۝٢٥
translation: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتࣱ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ ۝١١
translation: Surely those who believe and do good will have Gardens under which rivers flow. That is the greatest triumph.

arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ ۝١٤
translation: And He is the All-Forgiving, All-Loving—

arabic: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى ۝١
translation: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ ۝١٤
translation: Successful indeed are those who purify themselves,

arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ ۝١٥
translation: remember the Name of their Lord, and pray.

arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۝١٦
translation: But you ˹deniers only˺ prefer the life of this world,

arabic: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرࣱ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ ۝١٧
translation: even though the Hereafter is far better and more lasting.

arabic: وُجُوهࣱ يَوْمَئِذࣲ نَّاعِمَةࣱ ۝٨
translation: On that Day ˹other˺ faces will be glowing with bliss,

arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةࣱ ۝٩
translation: ˹fully˺ pleased with their striving,

arabic: فِي جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةࣲ ۝١٠
translation: in an elevated Garden,

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ ۝١٤
translation: ˹For˺ your Lord is truly vigilant.

arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ ۝٢٧
translation: ˹Allah will say to the righteous,˺ “O tranquil soul!

arabic: ٱرْجِعِيٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةࣰ مَّرْضِيَّةࣰ ۝٢٨
translation: Return to your Lord, well pleased ˹with Him˺ and well pleasing ˹to Him˺.

arabic: فَٱدْخُلِي فِي عِبَٰدِي ۝٢٩
translation: So join My servants,

arabic: وَٱدْخُلِي جَنَّتِي ۝٣٠
translation: and enter My Paradise.”

arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا ۝٩
translation: Successful indeed is the one who purifies their soul,

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ ۝٥
translation: As for the one who is charitable, mindful ˹of Allah˺,

arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۝٦
translation: and ˹firmly˺ believes in the finest reward,

arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ ۝٧
translation: We will facilitate for them the Way of Ease.

arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ ۝٣
translation: Your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ has not abandoned you, nor has He become hateful ˹of you˺.

arabic: وَلَلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرࣱ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۝٤
translation: And the next life is certainly far better for you than this one.

arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ ۝٥
translation: And ˹surely˺ your Lord will give so much to you that you will be pleased.

arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ ۝١١
translation: And proclaim the blessings of your Lord.

arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝٥
translation: So, surely with hardship comes ease.

arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرࣰا ۝٦
translation: Surely with ˹that˺ hardship comes ˹more˺ ease.

arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ ۝٧
translation: So once you have fulfilled ˹your duty˺, strive ˹in devotion˺,

arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب ۝٨
translation: turning to your Lord ˹alone˺ with hope.

arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِيٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمࣲ ۝٤
translation: Indeed, We created humans in the best form.

arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونࣲ ۝٦
translation: except those who believe and do good—they will have a never-ending reward.

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ۝١
translation: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—

arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ ۝٣
translation: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous,

arabic: ٱلَّذِي عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ ۝٤
translation: Who taught by the pen—

arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ ۝٥
translation: taught humanity what they knew not.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِي لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ ۝١
translation: Indeed, ˹it is˺ We ˹Who˺ sent this ˹Quran˺ down on the Night of Glory.

arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرࣱ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرࣲ ۝٣
translation: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months.

arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِيَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۝٥
translation: It is all peace until the break of dawn.

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ ۝٧
translation: Indeed, those who believe and do good—they are the best of ˹all˺ beings.

arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرࣰا يَرَهُۥ ۝٧
translation: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it.

arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ ۝٦
translation: So as for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺,

arabic: فَهُوَ فِي عِيشَةࣲ رَّاضِيَةࣲ ۝٧
translation: they will be in a life of bliss.

arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ ۝١
translation: Indeed, We have granted you ˹O Prophet˺ abundant goodness.

arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ ۝٢
translation: So pray and sacrifice to your Lord ˹alone˺.

arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِيَ دِينِ ۝٦
translation: You have your way, and I have my Way.”

arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابَۢا ۝٣
translation: then glorify the praises of your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for certainly He is ever Accepting of Repentance.

arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝١
translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “He is Allah—One ˹and Indivisible˺;

arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ ۝٢
translation: Allah—the Sustainer ˹needed by all˺.

arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝٣
translation: He has never had offspring, nor was He born.

arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدُۢ ۝٤
translation: And there is none comparable to Him.”

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ ۝١
translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak

arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ ۝١
translation: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I seek refuge in the Lord of humankind,
